prologue.002: Things buried below would sometimes be pushed ashore by the tide.
prologue.004: They were never meant to be conscious.
prologue.006: She lay on the shallows and [ruby=opened]opened[/ruby] her eyes.
prologue.010: I cannot remember my name. But somehow, I know how to walk upon water.
prologue.name_echo: From this moment on, [b]{playerName}[/b] will remember her choices.
prologue.011: A distant blaze lit her face.
prologue.013: I do not know them. But I do not want them to die.
prologue.014: She rose. The sea parted willingly before her.
awakening.001: When the light reached her, she finally found her footing.
awakening.002: Start from here? I feel as if I still remember something.
approach.001: The blaze drew closer. The sea retreated beneath her feet, as if it knew her.
approach.002: A little closer, and I can see clearly.
approach.003: Two ships. One was sinking; the other refused to leave.
shore.001: She stayed in the shallows and watched the blaze sink lower.
shore.003: The tide returned and covered her footprints.
protect.002: She stood before the ship that refused to flee. The sea rose as a wall for her.
adrift.001: Morning came. Nothing remained on the sea.
adrift.002: I still cannot remember my name.
